fields.description: Issue includes an editorial questioning the legality of newly installed parking meters at Miami International Airport; extensive coverage of Miami Beach political conflict involving City Manager Claude Renshaw, allegations of deception of the city council, and discussion of gambling influence; reporting on Miami municipal court cases exposing police conduct during a vice raid at the Lenox Hotel; advocacy against a proposed general sales tax with printed coupons for readers; local news on new furnished apartment projects entering the rental market; and notices on driver license renewals and summaries of Florida Attorney General opinions.
